reset.title: Reset your password
reset.sent: If that email is registered, a reset link is on its way.
reset.invalidLink: That reset link is invalid or has expired.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.instructions: We sent a verification link to your inbox. Click it to activate your account. Didn't get it? Resend below.
verify.resent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
verify.failed: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage the credentials that protect your account.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices signed in to your account right now. Revoke any you don't recognize.
sessions.empty: You're only signed in on this device.
sessions.revokeError: Could not revoke that session. Try again.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: Permanently delete your account and all of its data. You can sign back in during the grace period to cancel before anything is erased.
deletion.cancelError: Could not cancel deletion. Try again.
deletion.scheduled: Your account is scheduled for deletion on {{date}}. Sign back in before then to cancel.
deletion.alreadyScheduled: Your account is already scheduled for deletion.
deletion.error: Could not schedule deletion. Try again.

change.title: Change password
change.success: Password updated. Other sessions were signed out.
change.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current password
change.hint: Signing out of other devices for extra safety.

emailChange.title: Change email
emailChange.pending: Check {{email}} to confirm this change. Your current email keeps working until you click the link.
emailChange.sameAsCurrent: The new email must differ from your current one
emailChange.unavailable: That email address is unavailable. Please try a different one.
emailChange.hint: Your account email only changes after you confirm the link we send to the new address.

sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Add a second step at sign-in so a stolen password alone can't get in.
twoFactor.adminNotice: Admin accounts must enable two-factor authentication.
twoFactor.passwordRequired: Enter your current password to continue.
twoFactor.step1Body: Scan the code with an authenticator app like 1Password, Authy, or Google Authenticator. Or paste the secret below into the app.
twoFactor.step2Body: Each code works once. Save them somewhere you can reach if your phone is lost — they are the ONLY way back in without your authenticator.
twoFactor.step3Title: 3. Verify a code from your app
twoFactor.step3Body: Enter the six-digit code your authenticator app is showing right now to finish enrolment.
twoFactor.confirmDisable: Enter a current code to turn two-factor authentication off.
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code was not accepted. Try again.

challenge.title: Two-step verification
challenge.totpBody: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app to finish signing in.
challenge.backupBody: Enter one of your one-time backup codes to sign in.

provisional.passwordNotice: This account was created for a team invitation. Replace the temporary password before accepting or using RankMeFast.
